messages.subject: Pennington v Crossfield — disclosure deadline next week
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Nothing to do with the refinancing, but since you sit with the Pennington team — a heads up that the disclosure deadline on Pennington Industries v Crossfield Engineering is next Friday. If Grace mentions it, that's the litigation matter (WC-00111), not Mallory. I'm on it, just flagging so signals don't cross.

Tom
